files.src/PumpPair.il:
PROGRAM PumpPair
VAR_INPUT
    StartA AT %I0.0 : BOOL;
    StopA AT %I0.1 : BOOL;
    StartB AT %I0.2 : BOOL;
    StopB AT %I0.3 : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    RunA AT %Q0.0 : BOOL;
    RunB AT %Q0.1 : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR
    PumpA : Latch;
    PumpB : Latch;
END_VAR

        LD    StartA
        ST    PumpA.Set
        LD    StopA
        ST    PumpA.Reset
        CAL   PumpA
        LD    PumpA.Q
        ST    RunA
        LD    StartB
        ST    PumpB.Set
        LD    StopB
        ST    PumpB.Reset
        CAL   PumpB
        LD    PumpB.Q
        ST    RunB
END_PROGRAM

wrong.intent: lets Start win over Stop, so pump A restarts when both arrive together

files.src/Latch.st:
(* Latch: Q keeps its value between calls. Set turns it ON, Reset turns it OFF, and Reset wins when both are TRUE. *)
FUNCTION_BLOCK Latch
VAR_INPUT Set : BOOL; Reset : BOOL; END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT Q : BOOL; END_VAR
Q := Set OR (Q AND NOT Reset);
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

wrong.intent: never uses Reset, so no pump ever stops
gives pump B the inputs of pump A, so B copies A
never calls pump B, so RunB stays OFF
